The '''Teya system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teya IV]] and the primary star [[Teya]]. The system housed 5 planets, each labeled Teya #. This was counted outward, from the closest planet to the sun.
